how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_113.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|traddon|traddon.skill.deviator.desc: A unique skill that allows the user to deviate from their normal abilities.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.skill.devastator.de: A unique skill that allows the user to unleash devastating attacks.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.skill.refractive_sh: The golem’s outer layer is composed of hyper-compressed, high-purity crystals. This shell acts as a multi-layered filter that can bend, split, and neutralize magical energy upon contact.
Summon a cloud of crystal dust that obscures vision and damages enemies within its area.
Summon a blade of pure light that can cut through almost anything. The blade's power increases with the user's mastery of the skill.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.skill.resonant_core: The golem's core is a unique crystalline structure that resonates with the world's magic. By attuning to this core, the golem can temporarily enhance its abilities, gaining increased strength, speed, and magical resistance for a short duration.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.skill.total_reflect: A unique skill that allows the user to reflect and absorb incoming attacks, converting them into stored energy for future use.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.race.shardling.desc: A small, floating cluster of jagged crystals held together by a faint magnetic core. They are often mistaken for raw ore until they move.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.race.geode_golem.de: The crystals have grown into a humanoid shape. Their chest cavity contains a hollow "Heart" filled with glowing, liquid magicules
items.lang|traddon|traddon.race.prism_knight.d: A towering figure clad in armor made of interlocking crystal plates that refract light into dazzling displays. They wield a massive crystalline sword that can cut through almost anything.
items.lang|traddon|traddon.race.diamond_sovere: A being of pure, blinding light contained within a diamond-hard exterior. They no longer "walk"; they exist as a focal point of the worlds laws.
items.lang|trashslot|trashslot.hint.toggleOn: Press %s to enable the trash slot for this screen!
items.lang|trashslot|trashslot.hint.toggledOff: You've toggled off the trash slot! Press %s to re-enable it.
items.lang|trashslot|trashslot.hint.locked: Trash slot locked. Press %s to unlock it.
items.lang|trashslot|trashslot.hint.unlocked: Trash slot unlocked. Press %s to lock it.
items.lang|twilightforest|enchantment.twilight: Adds a chance for the attacker to gain the frosted effect after hitting the wearer.
Allows the Block and Chain to break blocks with a higher mining tier.
Adds a chance for the attacker to be set on fire after hitting the wearer.
Automatically recharges scepters when they run out if the holder has the recharge items in their inventory.
items.lang|twilightforest|gamerule.playersTfPo: Time (in ticks) that a creative mode player needs to stand in The Twilight Forest portal before changing dimensions.
Time (in ticks) that a non-creative mode player needs to stand in The Twilight Forest portal before changing dimensions.
items.lang|twilightforest|gamerule.tfEnforcedP: Some Twilight Forest biomes are locked until you defeat certain bosses in the dimension. Check your advancements for the progression order.
items.lang|twilightforest|gui.twilightforest.o:
Before proceeding, please note that Optifine is known to cause crashes, multipart entity visual bugs and many other issues.

Before reporting a bug, please remove Optifine first and check again to see if the bug is still present.

Optifine-related issues are not solvable on Twilight Forest's end!

This screen may be disabled in the Client Config.
Here's a selection of mods that we recommend using instead.
